About the Public Service Announcement event

Public Service Announcement is a Teamwork event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Public Service Announcement team event (2–6 secondary or postsecondary members), built around the 2026–27 topic “Maintain My Brain: Practicing the Pillars of Brain Health”: the science of brain health and dementia risk, the pillars of brain health, audience, message and tone, writing a 30-second script and storyboard, filming, audio and editing, copyright and credits, airing and measuring impact, the Round One upload (115 points) and the five-minute Round Two presentation (85 points). Includes timing math, survey analysis, copyright decisions and practice scenarios.
